meaning:
κιθαρίζω
[in LXX: Isa.23:16 (נָגַן pi.)* ;]
to play upon the lyre or harp: 1Co.14:7, Rev.14:2.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Even things without life, giving a voice, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
